content.json:
# 🛡️ Analytics Rule Tuning - Microsoft Sentinel
---
A single pane to **find noisy rules, measure detection quality, reduce false positives and prove tuning impact**. Use the **Time range**, **Rule** and **Entity type** selectors above to scope every section.

| Section | What you get | Key signals |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **SOC KPIs** | Headline numbers | Total alerts / incidents, avg noise %, active rules |
| **1 · Rule health & noise** | Volume & conversion | Alerts/day with tuning hint, incidents per rule, alert→incident conversion, trend (alerts vs created vs closed) |
| **2 · False positives & grouping** | Detection quality | Noise ratio (with TP%), FP rate (>30% flag), classification mix, alerts/incident, MTTR P50/P90/P99, auto-closure %, overlap |
| **3 · Impacted entities** | Who/what drives noise | Top users / devices / IPs, selected-rule entities, dynamic entity view |
| **4 · Performance** | Execution health | Failed runs, slow KQL |
| **5 · Fusion** | Correlation value | Fusion share, alerts by provider |
| **6 · MITRE ATT&CK** | Coverage & gaps | Alerts by tactic, **zero-coverage tactics in red** |
| **7 · Governance** | Change control | Who tuned which rule (SentinelAudit) |

> 🎨 Colour legend: **red** = needs action, **orange** = watch, **green** = healthy. Click any row and use *Open in Logs* to drill down or export to CSV.

parameters.name: SelectedRule
parameters.label: Rule (for exclusions)
parameters.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| distinct AlertName
| sort by AlertName asc

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| summarize Value = todouble(count())
| extend Metric = "Total alerts", Ord = 1
| union (
    SecurityIncident
    | summarize Value = todouble(dcount(IncidentNumber))
    | extend Metric = "Total incidents", Ord = 2
), (
    SecurityIncident
    | where Status == "Closed"
    | summarize Value = round(100.0 * countif(Classification in ("FalsePositive", "BenignPositive")) / count(), 1)
    | extend Metric = "Avg noise % (FP+benign)", Ord = 3
), (
    SecurityAlert
    | where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
    | summarize Value = todouble(dcount(AlertName))
    | extend Metric = "Active rules (fired)", Ord = 4
)
| sort by Ord asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: SOC KPIs

content.json: > **Tuning thresholds (adjust to your SOC):** target ~5 alerts/rule/day; flag rules > 20/day for 3+ days. FP rate > 30% over 14d = needs review. No alerts in 7d = validate data or lower threshold. Alert-to-incident conversion: higher is better (low % = alert noise not worth incident creation).

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| summarize Alerts = count(),
            DaysActive = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)),
            LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated)
        by AlertName, AlertSeverity
| extend AlertsPerDay = round(Alerts * 1.0 / DaysActive, 1)
| extend TuningHint = case(AlertsPerDay > 20, "raise threshold / add exclusions", AlertsPerDay > 5, "watch", "ok")
| sort by AlertsPerDay desc
content.title: Rule health / noise (alerts per day)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Status != "Closed" or Classification == ""
| mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds
| summarize Incidents = dcount(IncidentNumber) by Title
| sort by Incidents desc
content.title: Actual incidents generated per rule

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| extend Rule = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Analytic Rule Name"])
| summarize Alerts = count() by Rule, AlertName, AlertSeverity
| sort by Alerts desc
content.title: Alert -> analytics rule mapping

content.query:
let inc = SecurityIncident
    | mv-expand AlertId = todynamic(AlertIds)
    | extend AlertId = tostring(AlertId)
    | distinct AlertId, IncidentNumber;
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| join kind=leftouter inc on $left.SystemAlertId == $right.AlertId
| summarize Alerts = count(), AlertsInIncidents = dcountif(SystemAlertId, isnotempty(IncidentNumber)) by AlertName
| extend ConversionPct = round(100.0 * AlertsInIncidents / Alerts, 1)
| sort by ConversionPct asc
content.title: Alert-to-incident conversion per rule (low % = noise)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertName
| sort by Alerts desc
| take 15
content.title: Top 15 rules by alert volume

content.query:
union
(SecurityAlert
    | where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
    | summarize Count = count() by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
    | extend Kind = "Alerts"),
(SecurityIncident
    | summarize by IncidentNumber, CreatedTime
    | summarize Count = count() by Day = bin(CreatedTime, 1d)
    | extend Kind = "Incidents created"),
(SecurityIncident
    | where Status == "Closed" and isnotempty(ClosedTime)
    | summarize by IncidentNumber, ClosedTime
    | summarize Count = count() by Day = bin(ClosedTime, 1d)
    | extend Kind = "Incidents closed")
| project TimeGenerated = Day, Kind, Count
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Trend: alerts vs incidents created vs closed

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Status == "Closed"
| summarize Total = count(),
            TruePositives = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
            FalsePositives = countif(Classification == "FalsePositive"),
            Benign = countif(Classification == "BenignPositive")
        by Title
| extend NoiseRatio = round(100.0 * (FalsePositives + Benign) / Total, 1)
| extend TPRatio = round(100.0 * TruePositives / Total, 1)
| where Total >= 5
| sort by NoiseRatio desc, Total desc
content.title: Noise ratio per rule (FP + benign %)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Status == "Closed"
| summarize Total = count(), FP = countif(Classification == "FalsePositive") by Title
| extend FPRate = round(100.0 * FP / Total, 1)
| extend Review = iff(FPRate > 30, "needs review", "ok")
| where Total >= 5
| sort by FPRate desc
content.title: False-positive rate per rule (> 30% = needs review)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Status == "Closed"
| extend Classification = iff(isempty(Classification), "Undetermined", Classification)
| summarize Count = count() by Classification
| sort by Count desc
content.title: Closed incidents by classification
Alerts per incident (alert grouping candidates)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| summarize LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated), Total = count() by AlertName
| where LastAlert < ago(30d)
| sort by LastAlert asc
content.title: Rules with no recent alerts (review / retire)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Status == "Closed" and isnotempty(ClosedTime)
| summarize by IncidentNumber, CreatedTime, FirstModifiedTime, ClosedTime, Title
| extend TriageMin = datetime_diff('minute', FirstModifiedTime, CreatedTime)
| extend ResolveHours = datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0
| summarize Incidents = count(),
            TriageP50_min = round(percentile(TriageMin, 50), 0),
            ResolveP50_h = round(percentile(ResolveHours, 50), 1),
            ResolveP90_h = round(percentile(ResolveHours, 90), 1),
            ResolveP99_h = round(percentile(ResolveHours, 99), 1)
        by Title
| where Incidents >= 3
| sort by ResolveP90_h desc
content.title: Triage and resolve times per rule (P50/P90/P99)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| extend Hour = hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Hour
| sort by Hour asc
content.title: Hourly alert distribution

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| where tostring(Entities.Type) == "{EntityType}"
| extend Entity = coalesce(tostring(Entities.Name), tostring(Entities.Address), tostring(Entities.HostName), tostring(Entities.AppId), tostring(Entities.ServicePrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(Entity)
| summarize Rules = make_set(AlertName), RuleCount = dcount(AlertName) by Entity
| where RuleCount > 1
| sort by RuleCount desc
content.title: Overlap: same {EntityType} across multiple rules

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where Status == "Closed" and isnotempty(ClosedTime)
| summarize by IncidentNumber, CreatedTime, ClosedTime, Title
| extend MinutesToClose = datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime)
| summarize Total = count(), AutoClosedApprox = countif(MinutesToClose <= 5) by Title
| extend AutoClosePct = round(100.0 * AutoClosedApprox / Total, 1)
| where Total >= 5
| sort by AutoClosePct desc
content.title: Auto-closure rate (approx: closed <= 5 min by SOAR)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| where Entities.Type == "account"
| extend User = coalesce(tostring(Entities.Name), tostring(Entities.AadUserId), tostring(Entities.UPNSuffix))
| where isnotempty(User)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName) by User
| sort by Alerts desc
| take 15
content.title: Top 15 users by alerts

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| where Entities.Type == "host"
| extend Device = coalesce(tostring(Entities.HostName), tostring(Entities.DnsDomain), tostring(Entities.NetBiosName))
| where isnotempty(Device)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName) by Device
| sort by Alerts desc
| take 15
content.title: Top 15 devices by alerts

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| where Entities.Type == "ip"
| extend IP = tostring(Entities.Address)
| where isnotempty(IP)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName) by IP
| sort by Alerts desc
| take 15
content.title: Top 15 IPs by alerts

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName == "{SelectedRule}"
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| where tostring(Entities.Type) == "{EntityType}"
| extend Value = coalesce(tostring(Entities.Name), tostring(Entities.Address), tostring(Entities.HostName), tostring(Entities.AppId), tostring(Entities.ServicePrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(Value)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Value
| sort by Alerts desc
content.title: {EntityType} entities triggering the selected rule (build exclusions)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
| where tostring(Entities.Type) == "{EntityType}"
| extend Entity = coalesce(tostring(Entities.Name), tostring(Entities.Address), tostring(Entities.HostName), tostring(Entities.AppId), tostring(Entities.ServicePrincipalName))
| where isnotempty(Entity)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName), Severities = make_set(AlertSeverity), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by Entity
| sort by Alerts desc
| take 50
content.title: Alerts by entity ({EntityType})

content.json:
## 4. Performance and execution health

> Note: the `SentinelHealth` table requires *Health monitoring* enabled on the workspace.

content.query:
SentinelHealth
| where OperationName == "Scheduled analytics rule run"
| extend State = tostring(Status)
| where State != "Success"
| extend Rule = tostring(SentinelResourceName)
| summarize Runs = count(), LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated), Reasons = make_set(Description, 5) by Rule, State
| sort by Runs desc
content.title: Rules with failed / partial runs

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName) by ProviderName
| sort by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts by provider (Fusion vs scheduled vs others)

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
| mv-expand Tactic = todynamic(Tactics)
| extend Tactic = tostring(Tactic)
| where isnotempty(Tactic)
| summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName) by Tactic
| sort by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts and rules by MITRE tactic

content.query:
let allTactics = datatable(Tactic:string)[
    "Reconnaissance", "ResourceDevelopment", "InitialAccess", "Execution", "Persistence",
    "PrivilegeEscalation", "DefenseEvasion", "CredentialAccess", "Discovery", "LateralMovement",
    "Collection", "CommandAndControl", "Exfiltration", "Impact", "ImpairProcessControl", "InhibitResponseFunction"];
let fired = SecurityAlert
    | where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
    | mv-expand Tactic = todynamic(Tactics)
    | extend Tactic = tostring(Tactic)
    | where isnotempty(Tactic)
    | summarize Alerts = count(), Rules = dcount(AlertName) by Tactic;
allTactics
| join kind=leftouter fired on Tactic
| extend Alerts = coalesce(Alerts, 0), Rules = coalesce(Rules, 0)
| project Tactic, Rules, Alerts
| sort by Alerts asc
content.title: Tactic coverage including gaps (zero = no detections firing)

content.json:
## 7. Governance and audit trail

> Note: the `SentinelAudit` table requires diagnostic settings forwarding *SentinelAudit* to this workspace. Use this to enforce change management (who tuned which rule and when).

content.query:
SentinelAudit
| where SentinelResourceType == "Analytic Rule"
| extend Caller = tostring(ExtendedProperties.CallerName), Result = tostring(ExtendedProperties.Description)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, RuleName = SentinelResourceName, Caller, Status, Result
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Analytic rule changes (who tuned / deployed what)
